system.description: You phase an object within long range so it vanishes and reappears in your hands or within immediate range of you. You must be able to see the object and it must be something you could carry with two hands. If the object is held by a creature or behind a barrier, you must succeed on an Intellect attack against the creature or barrier to transport it. Action.
